_readme: Voices per character. The engine merges this file with library/<style-id>/voices.json of every installed style (this file wins).
To change one character's voice, add just that character here under "characters", e.g. "s10_oyen": { "elevenlabs_voice_id": "..." }. Only the fields you give are replaced.
elevenlabs_voice_id: the ElevenLabs voice used when VOICE_PROVIDER=elevenlabs. Replace it with any voice id from your ElevenLabs account:
elevenlabs.io > Voices > pick a voice (or add one from the Voice Library, e.g. filter Language = Malay) > the three-dot menu > Copy voice ID.

elevenlabs_voice_name is only a label for humans. The defaults are ElevenLabs premade voices (available to every account); they speak Malay with an English-leaning accent, a Malay voice from the Voice Library sounds more natural.
free: macOS 'say' voice name, speed in words per minute, pitch shift in semitones. On Windows only rate and pitch are used (any installed voice).
Gemini voices (voice name + style sentence) live in cast.json and library/<style-id>/cast.json. Change a Gemini voice there.
After changing a voice, only the lines of that character are regenerated.

gemini._note: Each Gemini model has its own free daily quota (about 100 requests/day for gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview). A style can point at another TTS model with "gemini": {"models": {"<style-id>": "<model>"}} in its library/<style-id>/voices.json.
